## Why This Is Asked
Tests system design thinking for multi-tenant CKNE-aware gateways and how to preserve SLAs under pressure.

## Key Concepts
- CKNE-to-capacity mapping
- Per-tenant degradation loop
- Global SLA guarantees
- Telemetry-driven rebalancing

```javascript
// Pseudo mapping from CKNE to edge controls
function ckneToEdgeControls(ckne){
  return {
    maxConcurrency: Math.max(1, Math.floor(100 * (1 - ckne))),
    samplingRate: Math.max(0, 1 - 0.9 * ckne),
    exposure: Math.min(1, 0.5 + ckne * 0.5)
  };
}
```
